prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Produce ONE neutral dialogue bust of Theodor Rheed for Terminus.
Image 1 is the NEW AUTHORITATIVE CHARACTER DESIGN "Reed final.png". Match this exact elderly broad stout dwarf: rounded broad nose, round ears, thick white eyebrows, swept-back white hair, huge loose white beard (NOT a single central braid), long white split moustache ending in TWO slender side braids with tiny gold bands. Black eyepatch on VIEWER RIGHT, his anatomical LEFT, strap across forehead and scar visible above it EXACTLY as image 1. One visible eye on viewer LEFT. Do not mirror.
Clothes from image 1: elaborate sleeveless long coat with enormous angular outward collar and fine swirling embroidery, a pale/gold waistcoat with horizontal panels and small toggle fasteners, cream puffed sleeves with bands above elbow and ruffled cuffs. Match round gold chest clasps and chain partly obscured by beard. Wooden tankard with metal top and bottom rims held securely by hand on VIEWER RIGHT. His other hand VIEWER LEFT open in an easy storytelling gesture.
Image 2 is STYLE ONLY, the old Rheed bust. Discard its facial proportions, eye patch side, single braid and plain waistcoat. Match its Coreto monochrome sepia ink finish, bold black outer contours, detailed black crosshatching and fine stippling, cream parchment highlights INSIDE character only. Translate the red/gold/cream costume of image 1 into warm sepia tonal values, no saturated red.
Neutral: attentive relaxed visible eye and relaxed closed mouth, warm composed resting storyteller, not smiling strongly, not angry. Preserve old dwarf age and broad stout build.
Framing portrait 3:4, upper body through waist, near frontal matching image1. Entire head hair shoulders both hands and full tankard comfortably in frame, transparent margins, lower torso cut only at bottom. Same upper-left soft light as Coreto. True transparent background, no white paper, no floor shadow, no scenery, no text, no icons. Final use504x672px. One bust only.
CRITICAL FRAMING CORRECTION: image3 is the nearly correct neutral bust. Reproduce its design and rendering faithfully but zoom out about12 percent so BOTH outer sleeves, elbows and fingertips have clean transparent margin of at least40 pixels on left/right. No outline may touch side edges. Preserve source tankard, eyepatch viewerRIGHT, beard, outfit, neutral face, no redesign. Bottom torso can meet bottom center.
inspecao_visual: Conferido lado a lado: identidade, figurino, acessórios, anatomia, leitura da emoção, enquadramento e transparência. Avaliação artística do autor pendente.
